inputs.label: Newborn deaths per 1,000 live births (neonatal mortality)
inputs.meaning: Deaths in the first 28 days of life, per 1,000 babies born alive. Breastfeeding support prevents a small share of them.
inputs.where: UN IGME 2024 (childmortality.org), neonatal mortality rate. A DHS survey also gives it, for regions too.
inputs.range: 6 (Sao Tome and Principe) to 39 (South Sudan), median 24 (45 sub-Saharan countries, UN IGME 2024)

inputs.label: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births (infant mortality)
inputs.meaning: Deaths before the first birthday, per 1,000 babies born alive. Infant minus newborn deaths gives the deaths after the first month, where most of the benefit is.
inputs.where: UN IGME 2024 (childmortality.org), infant mortality rate.
inputs.range: 9 (Sao Tome and Principe) to 72 (South Sudan), median 40 (45 sub-Saharan countries, UN IGME 2024)

inputs.label: Babies under 6 months exclusively breastfed
inputs.meaning: Share of babies under six months given only breast milk. Used only when the breastfeeding gap setting is above 0, to scale the benefit down where breastfeeding is already common. GiveWell's own calculation does not use it.
inputs.where: The latest DHS or MICS survey, or UNICEF's data warehouse.
inputs.range: 7% (Chad, 2022 survey) to 83% (Burundi, 2024 survey), median 51% (45 sub-Saharan countries, latest survey in each, 2010 to 2025)

inputs.label: Cost per mother and baby pair, all visits
inputs.meaning: The cost of all visits for one mother and baby pair.
inputs.where: Current pilot cost in Nigeria is $8 per case

inputs.label: Children who benefit per pair, counting later children
inputs.type: Judgement call: GiveWell's guess (MBW model, Nov 2024)
inputs.meaning: A mother who learns to breastfeed is likely to breastfeed her next children too. GiveWell counts each pair as two children and labels this a guess.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), row 12 (GiveWell's guess).

inputs.label: How far to scale the benefit by the breastfeeding gap (0 = not at all, 1 = fully)
inputs.meaning: At 1, the benefit is scaled by the share of babies not yet exclusively breastfed, compared with the trials behind GiveWell's estimate (82% not exclusively breastfed in their control groups). At 0.5 it goes halfway. Where breastfeeding is already common, the benefit is smaller.
inputs.where: 0 by default to match GiveWell's calculation, which does not do this. A review for GiveWell (Rethink Priorities, April 2026) found little evidence either way (very low confidence).

inputs.label: Government cost, as a share of the organisation's cost
inputs.meaning: What the government spends on the program, in cash or in kind, for every dollar the organisation spends. That money could have done good elsewhere, so GiveWell's leveraging adjustment takes off the good it would have done. At 0% there is nothing to take off.
inputs.where: 0% by default, as in GiveWell's MBW analysis, which applies no leveraging adjustment: in Connect programs the government gives permission but does not pay for the work. If a government co-funds the program, enter its share.

inputs.label: Funging adjustment
inputs.meaning: GiveWell's discount for the chance that others would have funded the program anyway.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024) applies none (1.00). The CHC model uses 0.93, from GiveWell's CHAI Bauchi ORS and zinc grant.

inputs.label: GiveWell benchmark, units of value per dollar
inputs.meaning: Every result is divided by this. GiveWell's funding bar is 6 times this figure (May 2026).
inputs.where: GiveWell's cost-effectiveness page, September 2026. Its MBW analysis used 0.00335, which makes results about 10% lower.

inputs.label: Fall in diarrhoea with breastfeeding support
inputs.type: GiveWell: MBW model (Nov 2024), meta-analysis of 6 trials
inputs.meaning: Across 6 trials with diarrhoea outcomes (10 study groups: some trials ran in several sites or arms), breastfeeding support cut diarrhoea by 16% (relative risk 0.84).
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), Meta-analysis tab (row 18 of the CEA tab).

inputs.label: Share of deaths after the first month from causes breastfeeding could reduce
inputs.type: GiveWell: MBW model (Nov 2024), from IHME GBD 2019
inputs.meaning: GiveWell assumes fewer diarrhoea bouts lower deaths from infections more widely (respiratory, enteric, malaria and others), capping causes it thinks unlikely (half of preterm and other neonatal causes, a quarter of sudden infant deaths). This is the capped share of all deaths after the first month.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), Mortality plausibility modeling tab, row 19 (IHME cause shares, low SDI).

inputs.label: Effect on newborns compared with older babies
inputs.type: GiveWell: MBW model (Nov 2024), from Olufunlayo et al. 2019
inputs.meaning: Breastfeeding support raises exclusive breastfeeding less in the first month than later, so GiveWell scales the effect for newborns by this.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), row 23 (from Olufunlayo et al. 2019).

inputs.label: Share of newborn deaths from causes breastfeeding could reduce
inputs.type: GiveWell: MBW model (Nov 2024), from IHME GBD 2019
inputs.meaning: As above, for deaths in the first 28 days, where preterm birth and other newborn conditions dominate.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), Mortality plausibility modeling tab, row 35.

inputs.label: Internal validity adjustment
inputs.meaning: GiveWell keeps 70% of the trial results, for weaknesses in the trials.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), row 29.

inputs.label: External validity adjustment
inputs.meaning: GiveWell keeps 75% again, as the trials' settings may differ from the program's.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), row 30.

inputs.label: Value of preventing a death after the first month (units)
inputs.meaning: GiveWell's moral weight for a death between one month and one year.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), row 39 (GiveWell moral weights).

inputs.label: Value of preventing a newborn death (units)
inputs.meaning: GiveWell's moral weight for a death in the first month.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), row 41 (GiveWell moral weights).

inputs.label: Value from higher income, as a share of the value from deaths averted, for SMC
inputs.meaning: GiveWell values longer-term development (income) effects relative to its seasonal malaria chemoprevention estimate.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), row 45.

inputs.label: Development effects of breastfeeding support, compared with SMC
inputs.meaning: GiveWell's score of the evidence for breastfeeding's development effects against SMC's (0.65 against 2.15).
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), Development effects tab.

inputs.label: Scaling for a younger group of children
inputs.meaning: GiveWell doubles the development value because the children are younger than SMC's.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), row 49 (GiveWell's guess).

inputs.label: Adjustment for effects not modelled
inputs.meaning: GiveWell's addition for benefits outside the calculation: birth spacing, skin-to-skin contact, deaths of children over one, illness and others.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), Adjustments for excluded effects tab.

inputs.label: Exclusive breastfeeding in the trials' control groups
inputs.meaning: Used only to scale the benefit by the breastfeeding gap.
inputs.where: GiveWell's CEA for Dimagi's MBW program design grant (November 2024), Uptake of breastfeeding tab, row 30 (weighted average).

inputs.label: Value of a government dollar spent elsewhere
inputs.meaning: What government money would achieve if it were not spent on this program. Used only for the leveraging adjustment.
inputs.where: GiveWell ORS and zinc spreadsheet, leverage and funging inputs.

inputs.label: Value of another funder's dollar spent elsewhere
inputs.meaning: The same, for money from other funders. Used only for the leveraging adjustment.
inputs.where: GiveWell ORS and zinc spreadsheet, leverage and funging inputs.

inputs.label: Chance the government would run the program without this funding
inputs.meaning: Used only for the leveraging adjustment.
inputs.where: GiveWell ORS and zinc spreadsheet, leverage and funging inputs.

inputs.label: Chance another funder would pay for it without this funding
inputs.meaning: Used only for the leveraging adjustment.
inputs.where: GiveWell ORS and zinc spreadsheet, leverage and funging inputs.

inputs.label: Chance the program would not happen without this funding
inputs.meaning: Used only for the leveraging adjustment.
inputs.where: GiveWell ORS and zinc spreadsheet, leverage and funging inputs.

inputs.label: Share of the program that would still happen if the government ran it
inputs.meaning: Used only for the leveraging adjustment.
inputs.where: GiveWell ORS and zinc spreadsheet, leverage and funging inputs.
